title: The endpoint of a planar constant-density arc of a 2-dimensional minimizing cone lies in the support and has the arc's density (via the sector lemma)
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ and let C ∈ 𝒟_2(ℝ^P) be minimizing in ℝ^P (IsMinimizingIn C univ), with ∂C = 0 (BoundaryVanishes C) and a cone (IsConeCurrent C). Let Q ⊆ ℝ^P be a 2-dimensional linear subspace, z, e ∈ Q with |z| = |e| = 1 and ⟨z, e⟩ = 0, k ∈ ℕ with k ≥ 1, and φ₀ > 0; write γ(φ) := cos φ·z + sin φ·e. Assume that for every φ with 0 < φ < φ₀ there is ε > 0 with spt C ∩ B_ε(γ(φ)) = Q ∩ B_ε(γ(φ)) and HasMassDensity C y k for every y ∈ spt C ∩ B_ε(γ(φ)). Then γ(φ₀) ∈ spt C and HasMassDensity C γ(φ₀) k.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) 2) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (z e : Euclid P) (k : ℕ) (φ₀ : ℝ), IsMinimizingIn C univ → BoundaryVanishes C → IsConeCurrent C → Module.finrank ℝ Q = 2 → z ∈ Q → e ∈ Q → ‖z‖ = 1 → ‖e‖ = 1 → inner ℝ z e = 0 → 1 ≤ k → 0 < φ₀ → (∀ φ : ℝ, 0 < φ → φ < φ₀ → ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ C.support ∩ ball (Real.cos φ • z + Real.sin φ • e) ε = (Q : Set (Euclid P)) ∩ ball (Real.cos φ • z + Real.sin φ • e) ε ∧ ∀ y ∈ C.support, y ∈ ball (Real.cos φ • z + Real.sin φ • e) ε → HasMassDensity C y k) → Real.cos φ₀ • z + Real.sin φ₀ • e ∈ C.support ∧ HasMassDensity C (Real.cos φ₀ • z + Real.sin φ₀ • e) k
